podcast.body: An early demo version of "Sappy," dating back to late 1988 or early 1989, years before Nirvana's breakthrough, was uncovered for the "Montage of Heck" documentary. This early sketch ultimately evolved into the version found on the "In Utero" album. "This demo uncovered for the montage of Heck documentary has to date to late 1988 or early 89 years before Nirvana broke through."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song appeared in its finished form on Nirvana's third album, "In Utero," released in 1993. "Sappy is a name of a song from Nirvana's third album in Yuduro, which came out in 1993."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song was originally titled "Verse Chorus Verse" and was considered as a potential album title before "In Utero" was chosen. "Then they thought about calling it verse chorus verse after a song that would end up being retitled sappy."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
